name: Header
description: A page header that introduces a person and their page: avatar, name, job title and the page heading. Use it at the top of portfolio, profile or “about” pages.
whenToUse: At the top of a portfolio, profile or personal page.

whenNotToUse.text: For a person in a list or card.
For a page not about a person.

anatomy.name: Avatar
anatomy.description: Extra-large Avatar; decorative, since the name is next to it.

values.meaning: Default: the header opens the page.
When the page already has an h1.

behavior.text: At the top level it is the page’s banner landmark; use it once per page.
Without avatar, the Avatar shows initials from name.

content: Name: as the person writes it.
Heading: what the page is about, e.g. the project name, in a few words.

guidelines.do: Keep one h1 per page: the Header’s heading or the page’s own, not both.
guidelines.dont: Leave headingAs at h1 when the page already has one.
guidelines.why: One h1 gives screen reader users a clear starting point.

guidelines.do: Pass the real name, even with a photo.
guidelines.why: The name gives the fallback initials and is the visible identity.

guidelines.do: Use it once at the top.
guidelines.why: It is the page’s banner landmark.

accessibility.role: banner landmark (header) at the top level, with a heading.

wcag.how: header landmark and a real heading.
The page heading describes the page.

examples.title: Profile header
examples.description: Photo, name, job title and page heading.
examples.code:
import { Header } from '@ds/react';

<Header
  avatar="/me.png"
  name="Osama Eldrieny"
  jobTitle="Design System Designer"
  heading="Multi-theme design system"
/>

examples.title: Without a photo
examples.code:
import { Header } from '@ds/react';

<Header name="Sarah Chen" jobTitle="Head of Products" heading="Portfolio" />

examples.title: Below an existing h1
examples.code:
import { Header } from '@ds/react';

<Header name="Sarah Chen" heading="About me" headingAs="h2" />

changes: role → jobTitle (role is an HTML attribute), title → heading, rendered as a real heading (headingAs, default h1).
name is required; no placeholder defaults.
Surface tokens (--header-bg-color, padding, radius, shadow) replace section tokens.

components.name: Header
components.description:
A page header introducing a person and their page: avatar, name, job title and the
page heading. Use it once, at the top of a portfolio or profile page.

name.description: The person's full name. Also gives the avatar its initials.

jobTitle.description: Their role or job title, e.g. "Design System Designer".

heading.description: The page heading under the person, e.g. the project's name.

avatar.description: Photo URL. Without it, initials show.

headingAs.description: Heading level. Default h1, since this usually opens the page.
